tasks.title: Model the task document with its schema-level limits
tasks.description: server/src/models/taskModel.ts: enums, dates, hierarchy, dependencies, relations, labels, assignees, checklist, watchers, recurrence, comments, attachments, custom map, workspace indexes and the pre-save hook that keeps completedAt in step with status.

tasks.title: Write the pure dependency-graph helpers
tasks.description: server/src/utils/taskGraph.ts: wouldCreateCycle and normalizeIds, unit tested in server/src/__tests__/taskGraph.test.ts.

tasks.title: Parse and build the task list query
tasks.description: server/src/utils/taskQuery.ts: parseTaskListQuery, buildTaskFilter, buildTaskSort, taskNumberFromSearch, normalizeLabels and the priority rank expression.

tasks.title: Reserve and backfill task numbers
tasks.description: server/src/utils/taskNumbers.ts: reserveTaskNumbers (atomic $inc on Workspace.taskCounter) and ensureTaskNumbers for tasks created before numbers existed.

tasks.title: Validate recurrences and compute the next dates
tasks.description: server/src/utils/recurrence.ts: recurrenceProblem, normalizeRecurrence, nextOccurrenceDates and describeRecurrence, all in UTC calendar days.

tasks.title: Declare the task router and its permissions
tasks.description: server/src/routes/taskRoutes.ts with protect plus requirePermission per route, bulk routes before /:id, and the /api/tasks alias in activeTaskRoutes.ts.

tasks.title: Create tasks with the full rule set
tasks.description: createTask: validation chains, dates, dependencies, assignees, sprint/epic/release resolution, stage from the workflow, custom values, number reservation, activity entry and notification.

tasks.title: Update only the editable fields of a task
tasks.description: updateTask: EDITABLE_FIELDS allow-list, stage/status synchronisation, hierarchy and release reconciliation, subtask regrouping, activity diff and the reload trigger when a recurring task completes.

tasks.title: Delete a task with the full cascade
tasks.description: deleteTask plus cleanUpRemovedTasks: subtasks, GridFS attachments, dependants, typed relations, epic references and time entries.

tasks.title: Typed relations and subtask moves
tasks.description: taskRelationController: addRelation/removeRelation with the inverse type written on both sides, blocks/blocked_by mapped onto dependencies, and moveTask with the parent rules.

tasks.title: Comments and GridFS attachments
tasks.description: taskExtrasController: addComment/deleteComment with the author-or-settings:manage rule, uploadAttachment/downloadAttachment/deleteAttachment with the MIME allow-list and sanitized names.

tasks.title: Serve the per-task activity history
tasks.description: activityController.getTaskActivity: workspace-scoped filter, before cursor, documented page limit, newest first.

tasks.title: Duplicate tasks and spawn the next occurrence
tasks.description: duplicateTask with the copiedFields whitelist and the optional subtask copies; spawnNextOccurrence clearing the rule on the completed task.

tasks.title: Bulk update and bulk delete
tasks.description: bulkTaskController: at most 100 ids, every task validated before any write, add/remove semantics for assignees and labels, and the shared delete cascade.

tasks.title: Follow and unfollow a task
tasks.description: watchTask/unwatchTask: atomic $addToSet/$pull for the signed-in user only, answering with the watcher ids.

tasks.title: Wrap every task endpoint in one API module
tasks.description: client/src/features/tasks/api.ts over client/src/utils/api.ts, including bulk, duplicate, watch, relations, move, activity, comments and attachments (downloads as blobs).

tasks.title: Make useTasks the single source of truth
tasks.description: Stale-while-revalidate cache, optimistic applyPatch with rollback, delete undo window with pagehide flush, subtask regrouping, live refresh and reload after server-side side effects.

tasks.title: Add the date, filter and task-key libraries
tasks.description: lib/date.ts, lib/filters.ts and lib/taskKey.ts, mirroring the server's list query and the calendar-day contract (CON-203), each with Jest tests.

tasks.title: Build the create/edit form on shared form rules
tasks.description: lib/taskForm.ts plus TaskFormDialog.tsx: title/deadline validation, dependencies, checklist, recurrence, custom fields required per project.

tasks.title: Build the detail surfaces for collaboration
tasks.description: TaskDetailDialog with inline edits, SubtaskList, TaskRelations, ConvertToSubtaskDialog, TaskChecklist, TaskComments, TaskAttachments, TaskActivity and TaskWatchToggle.

tasks.title: Wire the feature into the task page
tasks.description: TaskPage.tsx: useTasks, URL-held filters and view, create/edit/delete/detail dialogs, bulk handlers, undo snackbar and the CSV export.

tasks.title: Cover the server rules with unit tests
tasks.description: server/src/__tests__: taskQuery, taskGraph, taskController, recurrence, bulkTaskController, taskExtras, taskRoutes, epicRules and activity.

tasks.title: Cover the API end to end with integration tests
tasks.description: server/src/__integration__ against a real MongoDB: tasks, relations, comments, attachments and bulk.

tasks.title: Cover the client module with tests
tasks.description: client/src/features/tasks/__tests__: useTasks, filters, date, taskForm, taskKey, subtasks, recurrence, relations, comments, attachments, activity, bulk edit and checklist.

tasks.title: Pass the repository quality gates
tasks.description: pnpm --filter server typecheck && pnpm --filter server test; pnpm --filter client typecheck && pnpm --filter client test && pnpm --filter client lint; pnpm --filter client build (constitution CON-402).
